# A partner that has connected sends its proposal straight after its SID:
# this side wants the first, has seen the second, and refuses the second
# again when it is offered twice.  The message wanted ends with a Ctrl-Z on a
# line of its own; with nothing to send back, this side says FF.
@seen 41_Q2BBS
@answering
> FB P Q2TEST Q1BBS Q1TEST 40_Q2BBS 12
> FB B Q2TEST GBR ALL 41_Q2BBS 10
> FB B Q2TEST GBR ALL 41_Q2BBS 10
> F> E3
< FS +--
> Hello
> First line.
> ^Z
< FF
> FQ
< *** disconnected
@check accepted=1 forwarded=0 refused=0 pending=0
